negativeCellMethod: Inspect shipped application entry points, UI control/analysis-mode dispatch and audio routing in addition to bundled README and earlier actual installed-package sessions. A missing README keyword alone is not treated as proof. No new runtime performance measurements were made for this documentation change.

observed: Single AudioBuffer PlayerService; one gain and HPF/LPF route
Waveform and offline Ooura STFT graph controls
EasyCut sends WRITE_WAV after selection export
absentSurface: No live spectrum, stereo-field, stereo-correlation or LUFS/F0/onset views
No L/R/M/S monitoring matrix, five-band solo or headphone-EQ route
sukumo28.wav-preview.notes: Existing HPF/LPF is not labelled five-band monitoring solo.

observed: One WaveSurfer renderer/media player per track
Track add/remove/reload, waveform height/normalization, source metadata and PCM controls
Per-track play buttons; no spectral or loudness measurement UI
absentSurface: No STFT, live FFT/CQT, stereo-field/correlation, LUFS/F0/onset or export surface

huachao.audio-player.notes: The publisher describes synced playback. The shipped ut sync guard is initialized false with no exposed enabling control in the inspected entry; the matrix intentionally says Multiple files without asserting a shared clock.

observed: Compare session uses monoA/monoB/monoDiff and shared spectrogramConfig; L.compare playbackSource selects a, b or diff
Loudness summary includes integrated LUFS, LRA and truePeakDbtp
Selection spectrum uses Hann FFT4096 windows after selection; not a live spectrum panel
Playback output uses selected channel maps and volume gain to destination
Alignment, gain matching and residual/level difference controls; WAV/MP3/M4A/FLAC export
absentSurface: No live FFT/CQT peak-hold view, stereo goniometer or frequency-resolved L/R correlation view
No L/R/M/S monitoring matrix, five-band solo or headphone-EQ output chain
YongsooIm.audioscope.notes: A/B sample alignment r is not the same feature as stereo L/R phase correlation.

rowRationale.wave_stft: EAR/upstream/audioscope expose STFT; Audio Player exposes only waveform in its application UI.
rowRationale.files: EAR limit eight, verified in four/eight production-bundle stress; upstream single buffer; Audio Player multiple cards; audioscope exactly A/B.
rowRationale.linked_stft: EAR session shared zoom; audioscope shared A/B/diff analysis/session configuration.
rowRationale.live_overlays: EAR publishes one source-colored live snapshot per active track. Competitor application surfaces are offline spectrogram or waveform/selection analysis.
rowRationale.cqt: EAR live settings expose FFT/CQT, tilt/release/peak hold; audioscope chroma/scalogram are distinct offline representations.
rowRationale.field: EAR polarSample/polarLevel/lissajous; no matching competitor UI mode.
rowRationale.phase: EAR phaseRho is L/R per-frequency. audioscope correlation is cross-file alignment, not this measurement.
rowRationale.loudness: EAR and audioscope expose LUFS/LRA/true peak; no such analyzer in the other two applications.
rowRationale.features: EAR requests PitchYinFFT and onset flux profiles; not in competitor analysis modes.
rowRationale.matrix: EAR monitoringGainsForMode and monitor UI expose L/R/M/S. audioscope separate-channel display and selected A/B/diff maps are different.
rowRationale.bands: EAR setBandMask creates five crossover branches. Upstream HPF/LPF filters are retained but not equivalent.
rowRationale.eq: EAR shared monitor bridges AutoEq and profile import into playback biquads, also optionally baked into WAV export; no comparable correction path in the other applications.
rowRationale.export: EAR exportMix and upstream WRITE_WAV; audioscope export dialog; no export action in Audio Player.
rowRationale.alignment: Same-rate integer constant-delay estimate, explicit apply/reset, optional polarity compensation; playback/analysis/export share the aligned session copy. See doc/audio-alignment.md and doc/metrics/alignment/native.json.
rowRationale.meters: EAR exposes a stereo levelMeterComponent with L/R and M/S RMS/peak modes, while the other inspected applications expose waveform/selection readouts rather than a live L/R-M/S meter.
rowRationale.gain_match: EAR uses shared non-padded interval, stereo energy with equal-power mono pan; attenuation to quietest active source. audioscope has level/gain matching in pair comparison.
rowRationale.residual: EAR measures same-rate current session buffers with matching gains; apply Align separately first when needed. No residual audition/export mode.
rowRationale.eq_export: EAR opt-in uses enabled monitoring EQ snapshot incl preamp, biquads and listen-match gain, excluding master volume.

roadmapSource.policy: Integer-delay alignment is completed in v0.6. Remaining planned items retain their original scope, including Worker offload for long single-file F0/onset.
